# PHP Ledger

> PHP Ledger is open-source, self-hosted double-entry accounting software with a simple cash point of sale for small businesses, built on PHP 8.2+ and MySQL 8.4 and currently in development preview.

Status: development preview (0.1.4-preview, published 15 September 2026). This evaluation release includes opening trial-balance/CSV cutover review, a reconciled external unpaid-document register, reasoned period close/reopen, bank CSV matching/reconciliation, core CSV exports and an audited bundled POS module lifecycle. Account ledgers show opening, debit, credit, running and closing balances. The 0.1.4 correction makes Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet sections fit their panels and keeps running balances visible on tablets. Ordinary companies start with optional POS disabled. Customer/vendor subledgers and independently reviewed financial-statement packages remain unfinished; the unpaid-document register is not an operational AR/AP ledger. API/MCP read access is next, followed by controlled commands and optional AR/AP. Inventory/cost of sales, tax, detailed historical imports, multi-book, foreign-currency posting, translations, offline use, card payments and document scanning remain future capabilities. The public demo at https://phpledger.com/demo/ is synthetic, per-visitor and resets hourly; do not crawl or cite its data.

## Product

- [Home](https://phpledger.com/): what PHP Ledger is, with captures of the working development application.
- [Product](https://phpledger.com/product/): company setup, account statements and management, receipts and expenses, general journals, trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet and a cash scenario.
- [Point of sale](https://phpledger.com/point-of-sale/): a cash sale from a sample catalogue that posts a linked journal entry.
- [Download](https://phpledger.com/download/): the 0.1.4-preview package, its SHA-256 checksum, requirements and installation steps.
- [Roadmap](https://phpledger.com/roadmap/): what exists now, what comes next and what is not planned yet.
- [Support](https://phpledger.com/support/): installation assistance, training, troubleshooting and pilot enquiries by email.
- [News](https://phpledger.com/news/): release announcements and project updates.
